mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate relative to historical averages compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of all periods, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPI) exceeds 235, it signals persistent inflation that triggers central bank tightening, leading to higher discount rates and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 235, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 3-month moving averages indicates robust consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS rise > 0.5% from prior month, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 7.5%, the economy is in a high-unemployment regime where the Federal Reserve maintains accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 7.5, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payroll employment growth (PAYEMS) is a leading indicator of economic strength that consistently drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of all periods, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95, indicating a contraction in manufacturing and services, triggers risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 95, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) above their respective 3-month moving averages signals robust economic expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and GDPC1 are above their 3-month moving averages, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-driven expansion regime (INDPRO > 100), increased industrial output supports corporate profitability and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 100, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
